LESSON: COMMUNITY SERVICE LEARNING.

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade seven
Subject: SOCIAL STUDIES
Strand: Community Service learning
Topic 3.1: Community Service Learning.
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 20

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Community Service Learning., part of Community Service learning in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade seven SOCIAL STUDIES.

Key inquiry question: How can community service learning contribute to community development?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Community Service Learning. together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Communication and collaboration: Learners develop skills of listening keenly and effectively as they discuss and

brainstorm on types of projects and identification of relevant community problems.

● Critical Thinking and Problem Solving: Learners develop the skill of exploring complex problems as they identify

projects that can be undertaken in the community

● Self-efficacy: Learners develop self-awareness skills as they consider the steps in a CSL project and propose ways in

which they can present CSL findings

Values:
● Love: Learners respect others as they engage in a discussion on the benefits of CSL for self and community.

● Responsibility: Learners engage in assigned roles and duties as they implement the solution of the problem in the

community

Link to other Subjects:

All subjects as they provide PCIs and undertake CSL activities.
